newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany was top European air cargo market in 96.
newsitem.headline: Germany was top European air cargo market in 96.

text.p: The German air cargo market was the largest in Europe in 1996 with total sales worth more than 1.2 billion U.S. dollars, International Air Transport Association (IATA) figures showed.

Germany was the world's third-largest air cargo export market after the U.S. and Japan in terms of sales volume last year, figures released by IATA's Cargo Accounts Settlement System (CASS) in Germany said.

CASS is the official IATA accounting system between airlines and cargo agents. The following table shows total 1996 net sales revenue of IATA cargo agents in Europe, as disclosed to CASS, both inside and outside the CASS system.
Data and market share for other countries was not immediately available.
